theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_bv_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (V : ℝ), IntegrableOn w {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V) → ∀ G : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → (∀ y, ‖G y‖ ≤ 1) → |∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ G y)| ≤ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) * V + 4 * (m + 1) * ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |w y|
